dogecoin.text: @GuidoDisalle Memecoins like dogecoin and bitcoin aren't technically pyramid schemes, but they are similar. They are time bombs that can potentially go to zero at any time if enough people decide to cash out.

@GuidoDisalle Dogecoin has a larger market cap than Ford, but there's no real value there in any traditional sense. That's my point. And yes it's incredibly disturbing that Bitcoin is also a memecoin.
ETH is a different thing with actual functionality that has traditional value.

Trump memecoin is now bigger than Dogecoin and the largest memecoin behind Bitcoin (fully diluted value). $70 billion In 2 days. The fastest value creation in crypto history. Maybe in all of history.
I doubt it goes much higher unless to take on the #1 memecoin: BTC.

@steve_alarm @GraphCall I'm not sure what you mean, but if you're comparing bitcoin to dogecoin, I agree with you--bitcoin is a memecoin. I'm more interested in programmable crypto like Ethereum that have their own economies running exchanges, DeFi, NFTs, tokenizing real world assets, etc.
